inputs.original_text:
Open your eyes. You are being played by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the DHS with a carefully scripted theater coming straight out of JFK International Airport on Thursday. They want you to swallow the official narrative of random coincidence and sudden heroism because the Department of Homeland Security happily releases "video footage" showing an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent just happening to "jump into action" when a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line supposedly stopped breathing. 

It is all a managed spectacle designed to manufacture consent and polish the public image of border enforcement apparatuses. The timing, the cameras rolling, the precise orchestration—it is a textbook distraction maneuver to make you love the very agencies tightening the grip of surveillance and control. Do not fall for it.
